meta.title: Folder Sync — Two-way PC ↔ Google Drive folder sync for Windows
meta.description: Folder Sync keeps folders on your Windows PC and several Google Drive accounts identical: two-way sync with rclone bisync, runs only after your save settles, deletes go to trash, conflicts keep both copies.
meta.ogTitle: Folder Sync — your PC folders and Google Drive, always the same
meta.ogDescription: Two-way sync, a full mirror on disk, no lost files.

hero.title: Your PC folders and Google Drive,
hero.lead: Pair a folder on your PC with a Google Drive folder — Folder Sync syncs both ways every time you finish saving. Every file lives on disk, deletes go to trash, and conflicts keep both copies.

pipelineNodes.out: Pick an account for a job →

pipelineNodes.body: Pair PC ↔ Drive folders, choose Two-way or one direction, set the settle time; follow History and Console.
Bandwidth limits, proxy with Direct failover, Google Drive Trash and timestamped backup folders.

downloadPage.title: Download Folder Sync for Windows
downloadPage.description: Get the latest Folder Sync installer for Windows 10/11 64-bit. rclone included, two-way sync with Google Drive.
downloadPage.note: The file downloads straight from GitHub Releases.

install.title: Run `Folder-Sync-Setup-….exe`
install.body: If Windows SmartScreen warns you, click *More info → Run anyway*.

install.title: Follow the installer
install.body: Pick a folder (the default is fine) and click Install.

install.title: Open Folder Sync
install.body: From the Start Menu or the desktop icon. Sign in to Google Drive under **Drives** first, then create a job under **Jobs**.
